what_office_does.text: The attorney general is California’s chief law officer, enforcing state laws and investigating fraud and illegal activity. The office heads the Department of Justice, represents the state in court, and oversees law enforcement agencies, including district attorneys and sheriffs.
what_office_does.label: fact

candidates.headline: Gates says he would make communities safer by enforcing Proposition 36, prosecuting drug traffickers, and protecting victims.
candidates.core_case: Gates presents his experience as a trial attorney, prosecutor, and city attorney as preparation to strengthen public safety. He proposes combining enforcement of theft and drug laws with treatment, victim protection, and cooperation among residents and law enforcement.
priorities: Help people off the streets and into treatment
